{{Quote|Now you must die!|Gilsaria, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TNH" />}}
'''Gilsaria''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] who lived on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a major conflict fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Gilsaria fought and [[Death/Legends|died]] in a skirmish against a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who wished to obtain her [[Shard of Hatred]].<ref name="SWG:TNH" />

==Biography==
Gilsaria was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who belonged to a group of [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]] known as the [[Singing Mountain Clan]]. Gilsaria worked alongside her clan at their [[Singing Mountain Clan Fortress|stronghold]] on the [[Singing Mountain (Dathomir)/Legends|Singing Mountain]], a geographic feature of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a treacherous [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] by the name of [[Axkva Min]] attempted to escape from her [[Prison/Legends|prison]] in the [[Chamber of Banishment]], located deep within the [[Rancor Cave]] just nearby the [[Nightsister Stronghold]]. Meanwhile, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] worked alongside two important residents of a Dathomiri [[City/Legends|township]] known as [[Aurilia]]. They were a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] named [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarguillo]], and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] founder of Aurilia named [[Rohak]]. Rohak and Sarguillo informed the spacer that the only way to stop Axkva Min would be to gain access to her Chamber of Banishment by using the [[Key of Exile]]. However, the key had to be specially created by relying on [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to fuse four special shards; the [[Shard of Indifference]], [[Shard of Obedience|Obedience]], [[Shard of Pity|Pity]], and [[Shard of Hatred|Hatred]].<ref name="SWG:TNH" />

As it turned out, Gilsaria possessed the Shard of Hatred, without which the spacer could not succeed in entering Axkva Min's chamber. Because of this, the spacer traveled to the Singing Mountain Clan Stronghold, outside of which existed a large [[Gong/Legends|gong]]. The spacer sounded the gong, alerting the clan to the existence of the intruder. The spacer was met first by a Singing Mountain clan guardian, [[arch witch]], and [[dragoon]], all of which were defeated. Following their [[Death/Legends|deaths]], Gilsaria engaged the spacer in combat. Despite being skilled in combat, Gilsaria was no match for the spacer, and was killed. The Shard of Hatred was retrieved from her dead body, allowing the spacer to continue their mission to fuse the shards into the Key of Exile.<ref name="SWG:TNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gilsaria was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TNH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Gilsaria was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|"Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:TNH" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
